description: Writes 64 x 512 B blocks, reads them all back and checksums what was read. Unlinks its file before and after, so a repeat is the same workload.
expected_output_origin: computed independently on the host with identical uint64 semantics (benchmarks/workloads/src/b0expect.c); NOT yet observed from the target
metrics_note: target-side cycle counts are NOT available for application workloads: reading mcycle from a user program needs mcounteren/scounteren delegation that this kernel does not perform, and changing the kernel for measurement convenience is out of scope. Cycle metrics are deferred, reported as null, never zero.
disk_reset_policy: each sample gets a fresh copy of the same initial disk image; the program also unlinks its own file at both ends

image.note: The KERNEL is byte-identical to the accepted one (e990fb31...): the three programs live in fs.img, not in the kernel, and this build reproduced the accepted kernel exactly. The DISK differs and is therefore a different workload image. Results from this disk must never be compared to results from the accepted disk as though they were the same workload.
image.reproducibility_note: rebuilt in a different directory and both artefacts reproduced byte-identically; the kernel also reproduced the ACCEPTED kernel exactly

build: benchmarks/workloads/build-xv6-b0.sh (copies the imported xv6 tree, adds the three programs, builds; the generated tree is not committed)
